description: Create or update the vendor terms for an (item, vendor) pair. If a live link already exists it is updated; otherwise it is created. minimumOrderQuantity is the vendor's minimum order quantity for the item (item base UOM): pass a value greater than zero to set it, or omit/null to record no minimum. Terms are surfaced, never enforced. The item and vendor must both belong to the tenant and the partner must actually be a vendor. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

itemId.description: The item id (GUID) the terms apply to.

minimumOrderQuantity.description: The vendor's minimum order quantity for this item (greater than zero). Omit or null to record no minimum.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

supplierId.description: The vendor id (GUID) these terms are for.

name: upsert_item_vendor_terms
title: Upsert Item Vendor Terms
